# `tfctl get`

The `tfctl get` command fetches a single resource by ID or lists resources by type.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl get RESOURCE_OR_ID [ID] [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl get` command fetches a single resource by ID or lists resources by type. This is a convenience command that allows you to retrieve resources instead of using the [`tfctl api` command](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/api) to call specific endpoints.

Specify a resource type name, such as `workspaces`, and the command returns a list of all resources of that type. Specify an ID, for example `ws-abc123`, and the command fetches the single resource. You can also specify type and ID, for example `get workspace ws-abc123`.

## Arguments

- `RESOURCE_OR_ID`: (Required) Resource type name or resource ID.
- `ID`: (Optional) Resource ID. Specify when the first argument is the resource type.

## Flags

- `--all`: Paginate through all results. Fetches all pages of results automatically.
    - Optional.
    - Data type: boolean
    - Default value: `false`

- `--organization=NAME`, `-o=NAME`: Organization name.
    - Optional.
    - Data type: string
    - Default value: Auto-resolved from profile or Terraform `cloud` configuration

- `--page-number=NUMBER`, `-n=NUMBER`: Page number to fetch. The index starts at `1`. Ignored if `--all` is set.
    - Optional.
    - Data type: number
    - Default value: `1`

- `--page-size=NUMBER`, `-s=NUMBER`: Number of results per page. Ignored if `--all` is set.
    - Optional.
    - Data type: number
    - Default value: Varies by resource

### Pagination

Commands that list multiple resources are paginated. For details on pagination options and behavior, refer to [Pagination](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#pagination).

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate how to fetch resources using the API.

### List all workspaces in the active organization

The following example lists workspaces in the default organization.

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces
```

### Fetch a single workspace by ID

The following example fetches a single workspace using its ID.

```shell-session
$ tfctl get ws-abc123
```

### Fetch a workspace by type and ID

The following example fetches a workspace by explicitly specifying the resource type and ID.

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspace ws-abc123
```

### List all workspaces (paginate through all pages)

The following example lists all workspaces by automatically paginating through all pages.

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces --all
```

### List workspaces with custom pagination

The following example lists workspaces with custom page size and page number.

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces --page-size 50 --page-number 2
```

### List workspaces in a specific organization

The following example lists workspaces in a specific organization.

```shell-session
$ tfctl get workspaces -o my-org
```
